## Venue Profile
- 70 matches at Sylhet International Cricket Stadium: 28 bat-first wins vs 37 chases (40% bat-first) — chasing edge.
- Scoring benchmarks: avg winning score 176, avg chasing score 141 (range 61-254); winning template is death overs driven with 58 runs in that phase.

## Form Guide
- Rangpur Riders LWWLL; batting first scored 111, 181, 114, 178 — reached avg winning score (176) in 2 of 4; chasing 174/173 (W) — reached avg chasing score (141) in 1 of 1.
- Sylhet Titans LWLWW; batting first scored 180 — reached avg winning score (176) in 1 of 1; chasing 153/165 (L), 112/111 (W), 142/147 (L), 119/114 (W) — reached avg chasing score (141) in 2 of 4.
- With a chasing edge at this venue, Rangpur Riders's 1 recent chasing win(s) vs Sylhet Titans's 2 is a key form differentiator; bowling-first restrictions avg 173 (Rangpur Riders) vs 112 (Sylhet Titans).

## Head-to-Head
- 3 meetings in window: Rangpur Riders 1-2 Sylhet Titans. Most recent (2026-01-20) went to Sylhet Titans at Shere Bangla National Stadium, Mirpur.
- 2 H2H match(es) at this venue — same-venue H2H strengthens the signal.

## Key Matchup Factor
- Winning-template pressure point is death overs (41 runs on average in successful chases).
- Top picks — Rangpur Riders: Akif Javed (56 exp pts, conf 0.90), Dawid Malan (54 exp pts, conf 0.90); Sylhet Titans: Shohidul Islam (78 exp pts, conf 0.90), Khaled Ahmed (51 exp pts, conf 0.90).
- Key edges: Khushdil Shah vs Nasum Ahmed (12b, SR 292); Khaled Ahmed threat (124b, 10 wkts, econ 7.65); Rony Talukdar vs Nahid Rana (11b, SR 218); Mustafizur Rahman threat (144b, 8 wkts, econ 7.38).

## Preview Take
- Lean Sylhet Titans (-6) (ELO: Rangpur Riders 1615 vs Sylhet Titans 1533) — Recent H2H edge, Venue bias: chasing_edge, Fantasy/matchup edge.
- Toss/innings path: recent venue split is 2 bat-first wins vs 5 chases in the last 7.
